jobs.title: Oman Research Grant 2027
jobs.reason: A research grant is a genuine funded opportunity and entry-level-appropriate, and the candidate's research and writing skills transfer. However, the regional focus on Oman / Middle East studies sits well outside the candidate's core specialisms (international law, atrocity prevention, European security), and grants of this kind often assume relevant regional expertise the candidate lacks — modest fit and interest.

jobs.title: Doctoral Program in Peace and Conflict Resolution
jobs.organisation: European Wasatia Graduate School for Peace and Conflict Resolution, Europa-Universität Flensburg
jobs.reason: A doctoral program in peace and conflict resolution is entry-level by definition and the candidate's MSc satisfies the entry requirement; funding is not stated, so eligibility is given the benefit of the doubt. Peace and conflict / post-atrocity reconciliation is adjacent to the candidate's core interests, but the program's explicit orientation toward Middle East/West Asia candidates and its unclear funding hold the score to solid-but-not-top.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Fotografiegeschichte
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level research post (Master's required, not a completed PhD) that the candidate's degree satisfies, and the subject — critically framing photographs of German atrocities in occupied Europe, contrasting perpetrator and victim perspectives — sits close to the candidate's memory/post-atrocity interests. However, the essential requirements for demonstrated expertise in the photographic history of National Socialism and hands-on experience working with historical image sources and archival/documentary methods are a real skills gap the candidate cannot clearly evidence, which holds the score down. Languages are met (German native, English C2), so the "further European language" is only desirable.

jobs.title: Research Associate in International and European Law, Behavioural Science, and Sustainable Development (2 positions)
jobs.reason: This is a salaried doctoral-track research-associate post (TV-L E13, PhD-pursuing not PhD-required), entry-level and open to social-science candidates with an affinity for legal/regulatory issues — a plausible fit given the candidate's critical international law focus and MSc. The topic (international/European law with sustainable development, climate and behavioural science) is adjacent rather than core to atrocity prevention/transitional justice, and teaching duties plus the law-and-economics emphasis create some distance; German is only an advantage, so language is not a blocker.

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft für Kommunikation (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It is also a communications / social-media role — a partial skills gap — and finance-market advocacy sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Praktikum im Globalvorhaben „Investing in Resilient and Sustainable Global Supply Chains"
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a Praktikum / internship, which is excluded as a matter of policy, and it also requires current enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months. The supply-chain / due-diligence topic is only tangential to the candidate's core interests in any case.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in – Agentur für Wirtschaft & Entwicklung / develoPPP-Programmkommunikation
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum) that also requires current enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months — an excluded role type per policy. It is additionally a communications/marketing-focused role, a partial skills gap, and development-cooperation communications sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Postdoc) - Romanische Philologie / Sprachwissenschaft des Spanischen
jobs.reason: This is a postdoc position requiring a completed doctorate (Promotion) with a linguistic focus, which the candidate does not hold. It also requires C2 Spanish, which the candidate lacks. The field (Spanish sociolinguistics) is entirely outside the candidate's areas.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d) - Institut für Pharmazie, AG Molekulares Wirkstoffdesign
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed doctorate (Promotion in Pharmazie, Schwerpunkt Molecular Modeling) plus at least three years of post-degree professional experience — both unmet essentials. It is also a deep-technical computational pharmacy / molecular-modelling role far outside the candidate's field and skills.
